sql.space_scope:
SELECT canonical_conversations.id AS conversation_id, coalesce(CASE WHEN (canonical_conversations.kind = 'private') THEN accounts_1.platform ELSE space_bindings.platform END, accounts_2.platform) AS platform 
FROM canonical_conversations LEFT OUTER JOIN account_assignments AS account_assignments_1 ON canonical_conversations.identity_binding_id = account_assignments_1.id AND account_assignments_1.kind IN ('person') LEFT OUTER JOIN accounts AS accounts_1 ON accounts_1.id = account_assignments_1.account_id LEFT OUTER JOIN space_bindings ON canonical_conversations.space_binding_id = space_bindings.id LEFT OUTER JOIN account_assignments AS account_assignments_2 ON canonical_conversations.entry_presence_id = account_assignments_2.id AND account_assignments_2.kind IN ('yuki') LEFT OUTER JOIN accounts AS accounts_2 ON accounts_2.id = account_assignments_2.account_id LEFT OUTER JOIN persons ON persons.id = canonical_conversations.person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN spaces ON spaces.id = canonical_conversations.space_id 
WHERE canonical_conversations.space_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000019063' ORDER BY conversation_id
sql.space_display:
SELECT canonical_conversations.id AS conversation_id, canonical_conversations.kind AS conversation_kind, canonical_conversations.person_id, canonical_conversations.space_id, coalesce(canonical_conversations.identity_binding_id, canonical_conversations.space_binding_id) AS binding_id, canonical_conversations.entry_presence_id AS presence_id, canonical_conversations.thread_id, coalesce(CASE WHEN (canonical_conversations.kind = 'private') THEN accounts_1.platform ELSE space_bindings.platform END, accounts_2.platform) AS platform, CASE WHEN (canonical_conversations.kind = 'private') THEN coalesce(nullif(accounts_1.display_name, ''), persons.display_name) ELSE coalesce(nullif(space_bindings.display_name, ''), spaces.name) END AS conversation_name, CASE WHEN (canonical_conversations.kind = 'private') THEN account_assignments_1.status ELSE space_bindings.status END AS binding_status, account_assignments_2.status AS presence_status, canonical_conversations.generation 
FROM canonical_conversations LEFT OUTER JOIN account_assignments AS account_assignments_1 ON canonical_conversations.identity_binding_id = account_assignments_1.id AND account_assignments_1.kind IN ('person') LEFT OUTER JOIN accounts AS accounts_1 ON accounts_1.id = account_assignments_1.account_id LEFT OUTER JOIN space_bindings ON canonical_conversations.space_binding_id = space_bindings.id LEFT OUTER JOIN account_assignments AS account_assignments_2 ON canonical_conversations.entry_presence_id = account_assignments_2.id AND account_assignments_2.kind IN ('yuki') LEFT OUTER JOIN accounts AS accounts_2 ON accounts_2.id = account_assignments_2.account_id LEFT OUTER JOIN persons ON persons.id = canonical_conversations.person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN spaces ON spaces.id = canonical_conversations.space_id 
WHERE canonical_conversations.space_id = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000019063' ORDER BY conversation_id
 LIMIT 21 OFFSET 0

SELECT canonical_conversations.id AS conversation_id, coalesce(CASE WHEN (canonical_conversations.kind = 'private') THEN accounts_1.platform ELSE space_bindings.platform END, accounts_2.platform) AS platform 
FROM canonical_conversations LEFT OUTER JOIN account_assignments AS account_assignments_1 ON canonical_conversations.identity_binding_id = account_assignments_1.id AND account_assignments_1.kind IN ('person') LEFT OUTER JOIN accounts AS accounts_1 ON accounts_1.id = account_assignments_1.account_id LEFT OUTER JOIN space_bindings ON canonical_conversations.space_binding_id = space_bindings.id LEFT OUTER JOIN account_assignments AS account_assignments_2 ON canonical_conversations.entry_presence_id = account_assignments_2.id AND account_assignments_2.kind IN ('yuki') LEFT OUTER JOIN accounts AS accounts_2 ON accounts_2.id = account_assignments_2.account_id LEFT OUTER JOIN persons ON persons.id = canonical_conversations.person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN spaces ON spaces.id = canonical_conversations.space_id 
WHERE coalesce(CASE WHEN (canonical_conversations.kind = 'private') THEN accounts_1.platform ELSE space_bindings.platform END, accounts_2.platform) = 'telegram' ORDER BY conversation_id
sql.telegram_display:
SELECT canonical_conversations.id AS conversation_id, canonical_conversations.kind AS conversation_kind, canonical_conversations.person_id, canonical_conversations.space_id, coalesce(canonical_conversations.identity_binding_id, canonical_conversations.space_binding_id) AS binding_id, canonical_conversations.entry_presence_id AS presence_id, canonical_conversations.thread_id, coalesce(CASE WHEN (canonical_conversations.kind = 'private') THEN accounts_1.platform ELSE space_bindings.platform END, accounts_2.platform) AS platform, CASE WHEN (canonical_conversations.kind = 'private') THEN coalesce(nullif(accounts_1.display_name, ''), persons.display_name) ELSE coalesce(nullif(space_bindings.display_name, ''), spaces.name) END AS conversation_name, CASE WHEN (canonical_conversations.kind = 'private') THEN account_assignments_1.status ELSE space_bindings.status END AS binding_status, account_assignments_2.status AS presence_status, canonical_conversations.generation 
FROM canonical_conversations LEFT OUTER JOIN account_assignments AS account_assignments_1 ON canonical_conversations.identity_binding_id = account_assignments_1.id AND account_assignments_1.kind IN ('person') LEFT OUTER JOIN accounts AS accounts_1 ON accounts_1.id = account_assignments_1.account_id LEFT OUTER JOIN space_bindings ON canonical_conversations.space_binding_id = space_bindings.id LEFT OUTER JOIN account_assignments AS account_assignments_2 ON canonical_conversations.entry_presence_id = account_assignments_2.id AND account_assignments_2.kind IN ('yuki') LEFT OUTER JOIN accounts AS accounts_2 ON accounts_2.id = account_assignments_2.account_id LEFT OUTER JOIN persons ON persons.id = canonical_conversations.person_id LEFT OUTER JOIN spaces ON spaces.id = canonical_conversations.space_id 
WHERE coalesce(CASE WHEN (canonical_conversations.kind = 'private') THEN accounts_1.platform ELSE space_bindings.platform END, accounts_2.platform) = 'telegram' ORDER BY conversation_id
 LIMIT 21 OFFSET 0
